description:
Synopsis for W912CH-26-R-0055 – Ground Hop Kit

ARMY CONTRACTING COMMAND – Detroit Arsenal proposes to solicit and award a One Time Buy with 100% Option Firm Fixed Price contract. This action will be 100% total small business set aside for competition for the following item:

NSN: 4910-01-115-6283
Part Number: 12298101
Noun: Ground Hop Kit
Production Quantity: 38 EA
Option Quantity: 38 EA
NAICS Code: 334419 - Other Electronic Component Manufacturing
Unit of Issue: Each
Inspection: Origin
Acceptance: Origin
FOB Point: Destination
Level of Preservation: Military
Level of Packaging: A

The solicitation, W912CH-26-R-0055, is anticipated for release in two to four weeks and will contain the required technical information and a specific due date and time.


CAUTION: This solicitation will be issued electronically as will any amendments thereto. Because of this, the Government is under no obligation and is, in fact, unable to maintain a mailing list. The burden is therefore on any interested parties to periodically access the above internet address in order to obtain any amendments which may be issued. Failure to obtain any amendments and to respond to them prior to the date and time set for receipt of proposals may render your proposal nonresponsive and result in the rejection of the proposal. NOTICE TO ALL CONTRACTORS: All contractors who provide goods/services to the Department of Defense (DoD) must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM). You may register via the Internet at https://www.sam.gov/SAM/pages/public/loginFAQ.jsf. Further information may be obtained through the internet at: https://www.sam.gov/SAM/pages/public/loginFAQ.jsf. If you have any further questions, please contact MaKenzie Bailey at makenzie.d.bailey.civ@army.mil .
